text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Despite finishing her normal routine,
Sirius Symboli showed no signs of leaving.

text_block_list.name: Sirius Symboli
choice_data_list: You should sit this one out today.

text_block_list.name: Sirius Symboli
text_block_list.text: Oh? You really said it now!

text_block_list.name: Sirius Symboli
text_block_list.text:
If that's your choice, then I gotta respect it.
Alright, bring it on.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Sirius Symboli's training
continued until it grew dark.

text_block_list.name: Sirius Symboli
text_block_list.text:
Whoa, whoa, don't tell me you're gonna
throw in the towel before I do, are ya?

text_block_list.name: Sirius Symboli
text_block_list.text:
I have no use for useless mutts. If you want to be my puppy,
take responsibility for your own choices until the very end. Understood?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
And so, the training continued
right up until curfew.

text_block_list.name: Sirius Symboli
text_block_list.text: Huh? You're not the one who gets to decide that.

text_block_list.name: Sirius Symboli
text_block_list.text:
Hmph... Seems like disciplining this little pup
is way more urgent than solo training.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
I ended up listening to her discipline—or rather, her suggestions,
but at least I managed to avoid doing extra training.
